correctness.rationale: Compatible s-edge directed path constraints have probability 1/(n)_s, giving exact means. For fixed joint factorial moments, repeated underlying unordered edges require at least j+1 distinct relation uses and lose k/n=O(n^(-2/j)); disjoint edges but reused relation indices lose O(1/k). Fully disjoint index groups factor, yielding independent Poisson factorial moments and then total variation on integer lattices. Exact finite checker independently tests rational means and edge probabilities. Boundary regimes follow Markov and monotonicity.
